physical.assumption: single unidirectional EV request followed by energy-conserving repayment; hypothetical reference/limits/deadline, not calibrated or real willingness

generator: for each repetition independent seed; six mechanisms share delay=30*uniform_integer(0..4) s, partial amplitude Uniform(.45,1.05) kW, early_end=1200+30*uniform_integer(0..4), dropout_start=960+30*uniform_integer(0..3), dropout_duration=60+30*uniform_integer(0..4). Request reduction step/ramp/early/interrupted peak1.5; ramp600s left-grid rise. Native repayment starts1800 at1.5kW, final fractional bin exactly repays request deficit. IID Gaussian native observation noise, same standard draws for both sigmas and all mechanisms; 30s is average of three native bins, sigma/sqrt(3). Shared variants not independent cases.

methods.F0_raw_rule: frozen D106 features.extract on raw reference and observed power; onset .15kW, target .9*q, recovery band .15kW, dwell ceil(30/dt) bins
methods.F1_segment_rule: exact unpruned constant-mean penalized DP smoothing finite contiguous blocks separately within known pre/request/post windows; min segment ceil(30/dt); penalty=3*sigma_effective^2*log(block_n), no tuning; same D106 feature rules on fitted curve. Blocks shorter than min stay raw. DP cuts are approximation, not business phases.
methods.duration: longest contiguous request run reduction>=.15kW lasting >=30s; retrospective observed-threshold duration, not promised capacity duration
methods.raw_integral: both methods always use original raw request signed energy/Y; no smoothed energy substitution or clipping
methods.missing: any missing request bin makes request energy, stage, onset/target/duration and power-recovery unavailable; any missing post makes power-recovery and total debt unavailable; no gap interpolation
methods.energy_balance: separate common observed raw cumulative debt since600; known IID normal fixed observed-end interval z(.975)*sigma_eff*sqrt(sum dt^2)/3600; numerical epsilon=.01kWh. Full end3600 upper<=epsilon within_margin, lower>epsilon above_margin, otherwise unresolved. Short end2100 status right_censored (interval only describes observed end); missing interval unavailable. No first exact-zero recovery claim or inferred service acceptance. No action still has well-defined relative-energy balance.

targets: mean-power interval observable noiseless criterion at each sample resolution, independently evaluated after observed outputs persist. Physical action onset is separately distinguished from threshold onset on ramps. No continuous hardware-delay identification. Truth for raw net energy/debt is exact rectangular area; missing/censored observations retain availability states, all denominators reported.
evaluation: 25 independent base draws x6 mechanism variants=150 event variants; 2400 observation variants after sigma/dt/availability, 4800 method outputs. Full paired F1-minus-F0 timing/duration/power-curve errors; no-response false detections; all true-onset/recovered counts including misses; MAE conditional denominator explicitly separate; availability/integration/energy interval coverages; per-case counters, preserve ramp approximation and sampling failures. No post-test tuning/expansion to chase success.
selection: no fitting hyperparameter selection or predictive training/test split; protocol and algorithms frozen before new Monte Carlo draws; this is extraction evaluation, not response prediction
truth_isolation: generator native hidden signal saved under work; raw data contains only time/reference/observed power/known sigma and observation design IDs. Extractor accepts curve and declared observation error only, never mechanism or hidden labels. Observed outputs/fit arrays SHA saved before evaluator reads hidden native signals.
scope: B1 features only, no learned representation/B2/B4 startup, no new dependencies/GPU/network upload/UI; previous experiments/live models unchanged, simulation not real resource validation
reuse: GitHub deepcharles/ruptures BSD2 maintained offline changepoint library evaluated; installed state inspected before run. Existing transparent exact DP suffices bounded n<=360, reuse NumPy and frozen D106 feature module, no PELT or linear-complexity claim; vectorized prefix DP checked against original scalar implementation/exhaustive tiny oracle.
